subject: extn
title: EXTN.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 79 (CS-7). EXTN (existentialism) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: PRO-TF-C and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From PRO-TF-C: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From DYM-F: MT-INFO (multi-information) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From MT-INFO: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INTR: POST (postulation) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PHY-U-P: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: PRI-INT.
